property_summary: For every caller address, only the original admin (the deployer) can successfully change C.owner via setOwner; the mutant additionally allows the current owner to change owner, violating this rule when caller == owner != admin.
change_summary: Changed the require message but kept logic identical (no behavioral change) - REMOVED: Not included because it would be equivalent; instead created a stronger check requiring both admin and owner, preventing admin-only calls from succeeding alone.
